spec.name: 主页减红与透视修正v02
spec.file: 02_交子铺台面_主页_配色透视修正_v02_20261122.png
spec.prompt:
Edit image1's game HOME SCREEN in place. The user specifically critiques: 颜色太鲜艳，红色太多，注意物体透视，logo也还需要优化. Retain its same shop-counter layout, front camera, object groups, empty middle counter, four bottom menu buttons, NO characters anywhere, and landscape aspect. Image2 is the newly refined logo to replace the current oversaturated bulky sign.

COLOR BALANCE — make a meaningful local-material redesign, NOT a grey/desaturation filter:
About 70% of screen should be natural warm WOOD/TAN and IVORY, 20% grey-sage/charcoal and 10% restrained oxide red/bronze accents.
Counter top/front/beams/posts/shelf must be natural light-to-medium weathered warm WALNUT/TAN #A58C70 / #B79B79, low saturation brown, not red lacquer, orange or terracotta. Their large planes should clearly read as brown wood cut from paper, with NO busy grain or cracking. The central counter top warm tan distinct from slightly darker apron, coherent light.
Replace BOTH oversized red top-corner curtains with quiet IVORY/FLAX fabric cut-paper folds, a single narrow grey-sage hem. Retain their exact curved corner placement.
Replace the two red/orange lantern bodies with softly lit pale RICE-PAPER CREAM lanterns, fine muted-bronze ribs and small muted-red ties only. No vivid red lanterns.
Keep window paper warm pale cream; beams taupe wood; background wall/small panel accents slate grey-sage #687E73 instead of saturated teal. Rolled-paper bundles ivory with ONE faded rust band; holder muted grey-sage. The limited exterior hills/leaf shapes stay pale sage.
Keep a little deep oxide red ONLY in logo lettering, the small seals, and the 開始营业/开始营业 primary button. These should draw focus without the entire environment being red. No bright yellow metallic frame, glow or oversaturated orange shadow.
Preserve freshness and warm clear light, not muddy, gloomy, sepia, faded vintage, or grey fog. Shadow clean and gentle; ivory and dark ink remain strong.

LOGO: integrate image2's same rounded Chinese 交子 / 赶工记 glyphs and thin layered ivory paper, muted brick lettering, small note+bronze coin, small cream cloud and tiny seal. Reduce the hanging sign's occupied width/height about 10% from image1 while keeping centered on same beam. Logo typography readable and same natural proportions, no stretching, no extra title. Remove previous thick yellow/teal bumper layers. TWO simple cords from actual upper beam support it. No black/transparent square backdrop from image2, only the shaped logo. Its shallow paper layers fit this shop material rather than glossy foam.

PERSPECTIVE — redraw all countertop props with ONE coherent camera above the counter, about 22 degrees looking down:
Counter long front/back edges remain parallel in this centered view; left/right depth edges share the same depth direction and horizon. Objects physically sit on this SAME horizontal plane.
LEFT paper stack: all rectangular sheets share parallel edge families, top face foreshortens correctly (short visible depth), vertical stacks align and paper band wraps across top and down front with continuous shape. No skewed top sheet/depth contradiction.
Two square cinnabar seal blocks: front/right faces and top rectangle coherent, vertical edges straight, base planes flush to counter; they should be small not furniture.
Coins: three flat square-hole coins LYING on the table. Their circular faces project to shallow ellipses, NOT upright circles; each square hole foreshortens on exactly the same plane as its coin. Coin shadows contact table; no tilted floating coins.
RIGHT inkstone: a LOW dark grey shallow tray. Outer rim and inner cavity are concentric matching elliptical foreshortening. Not a tall round basin. Brush rests diagonally across near/far rims with credible two contact points, bristle rests just into ink and handle projects toward rear-right; connected continuous brush axis, no floating brush or bristle mismatch.
Ledger: two rectangular page halves meet at ONE central spine and sit naturally on tabletop, a single coherent foreshortened plane with restrained slight page curve. Red grid lines follow paper perspective and stop at edges, not a flat front-facing texture pasted over tilted paper.
Brush/paper holder: straight upright wall planes, opening at top uses same viewpoint, paper strips emerge inside its opening. Preserve right cluster size hierarchy and empty center. No new props.

Keep precisely four bottom labels and same footprints: 开始营业 primary in subdued oxide red/ivory; 继续 in muted grey on ivory (disabled), 图鉴 and 设置 dark ink on ivory. All four tags have thin shallow paper layers, calm clipped corners and a tiny attachment point to counter apron, no thick gold borders. Preserve crisp readable Chinese, original UI hierarchy and safe margin.

GEOMETRIC PAPER COLLAGE: broad clean faces, designed folds in props, very short consistent contact/paper shadows, subtle restrained material. No CGI plastic, photo woodgrain, noisy fabric, dusty particles, heavy black painterly contours, ornate additions, animals, humans, account bars or changed functions. This should be a controlled calmer and structurally more credible version of image1, not a different page composition.
